def const_value(requires):
    if requires is None:
        return True
    if requires[0] == "const":
        return bool(requires[2])
    if requires[0] == "not":
        return not const_value(requires[1])
    raise AssertionError(requires)


def expected(campaign, gen, rng, corrupt=()):
    types_by_name = {t["name"]: t for t in campaign["types"]}
    modules = {m["name"]: m for m in campaign["modules"]}
    pipes = campaign["pipes"]
    machine = campaign["machine"]
    plans = []
    entry_info = {}
    for entry in campaign["entries"]:
        order = oracle_order(modules, campaign["calls"], pipes, entry)
        declarations = oracle_declarations(types_by_name, order, modules)
        has_pipes = any(p["target"] == entry for p in pipes)
        slots, flag, variables = oracle_layout(types_by_name, modules[entry], has_pipes)
        plans.append({"entry": entry, "modules": order, "types": declarations,
                      "slots": [[n, list(p), w] for n, p, w, k, t in slots],
                      "flag": flag, "variables": variables})
        accepted = all(const_value(modules[f]["requires"])
                       for f in oracle_applications(pipes, modules, entry))
        entry_info[entry] = (slots, flag, variables, accepted, has_pipes)

    records = []
    corpus = []
    table = {}
    for position, run in enumerate(campaign["runs"]):
        entry = run["entry"]
        slots, flag, variables, accepted, has_pipes = entry_info[entry]
        invalid = run.get("_invalid", False)
        values = run["_values"]
        result = run["_result"]
        if invalid:
            records.append({"status": "INVALID_TEST"})
            continue
        expected_flag = 0 if accepted else 1
        got_flag = run.get("_flag", 0)
        if has_pipes and got_flag != expected_flag:
            records.append({"status": "INVALID_TEST"})
            continue
        if not accepted or not const_value(modules[entry]["requires"]):
            records.append({"status": "FILTERED"})
            continue
        commands, cost = [], 0
        if machine is not None:
            enabled = [const_value(t["when"]) for t in machine["transitions"]]
            outcome = oracle_prepare(machine, enabled, values[machine["state_param"]])
            if outcome is None:
                records.append({"status": "UNREACHABLE"})
                continue
            commands, cost = outcome
            commands = list(commands) + [values[machine["message_param"]]]
        key = (entry, json.dumps(values, sort_keys=True))
        if key in table:
            index = table[key]
            corpus[index]["witnesses"].append(position)
            records.append({"status": "DUPLICATE", "case": index,
                            "model_result": result})
        else:
            index = len(corpus)
            table[key] = index
            corpus.append({"entry": entry, "inputs": values, "cost": cost,
                           "commands": commands, "witnesses": [position]})
            records.append({"status": "READY", "case": index,
                            "model_result": result})
    return {"plans": plans, "records": records, "corpus": corpus}


def craft(campaign, gen, rng, count=6):
    """Attach runs with oracle metadata to the campaign."""
    entries = campaign["entries"]
    runs = []
    for i in range(count):
        entry = rng.choice(entries)
        mutate = rng.choice([None, None] + MUTATIONS) if rng.random() < 0.5 else None
        payload, values, result, invalid = encode_run(campaign, gen, rng, entry, mutate)
        # the flag as recorded in the payload
        modules = {m["name"]: m for m in campaign["modules"]}
        pipes = campaign["pipes"]
        has_pipes = any(p["target"] == entry for p in pipes)
        accepted = all(const_value(modules[f]["requires"])
                       for f in oracle_applications(pipes, modules, entry))
        flag = 0 if accepted else 1
        if has_pipes and rng.random() < 0.25:
            payload["ktest"] = None      # handled below
            flag = 1 - flag
        payload["_values"] = values
        payload["_result"] = result
        payload["_invalid"] = invalid
        payload["_flag"] = flag
        runs.append(payload)
    campaign["runs"] = runs
    return campaign
